site.name: Air Line Mine
overview: Air Line Mine is a documented historic gold-silver mine in Clear Creek County, preserved as a named mine feature on Central City-area topographic mapping.
moreHistory: USGS-derived mapping places the Air Line Mine near 39.783877, -105.549165 at about 9,478 feet elevation. The mapped mine locality identifies the historic property; no claim is made that a surviving shaft, portal, or other opening has been field-verified or is accessible today.

sourceReferences.title: USGS-derived Air Line Mine topographic feature record
